_comment: ngsolve thermal_structural#3 (two-way coupling needs Picard sweeps; one-way is 5-20% off when k depends on the deformation). The Picard loop reaches ||dT||/||T|| and ||du||/||u|| < 1e-4 in 6 sweeps with a monotone residual history (1.54e-1, 1.93e-2, 2.59e-3, 6.92e-4, 5.29e-5), and the one-way field is 13.89% away from the converged one in relative L2 -- inside the documented 5-20% band and the documented 3-10 sweeps.
